jobs.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium desktop LANDING PAGE DESIGN for Minor AI, Russian language, 1440px wide by roughly 2160px tall, 4 generous distinct sections. Flat website screenshot, no browser/device outer frame around page. Brand: graphite #121212, white SF Pro-like/Swiss grotesk typography, mint #2FFF9E highlights, sky/lilac only inside map content. Elegant spacious editorial studio design, realistic readable UI product visuals. No gradient type, no fake reviews/user counts, no invented awards, no giant generic blobs. Use text wordmark 'Minor AI', DO NOT invent or redraw a logo. Phone mockup inside hero is okay. References are existing app concept style references, not final website screenshots. Navigation 'Возможности', 'Тарифы', 'Поддержка', 'RU / EN', white small 'Скачать'. Clear primary CTA 'Скачать для iPhone' and secondary 'Посмотреть пример'. Four sections total; don't cram a long full site into microtext. Use actual readable product-related copy. No pricing claims. Footer links 'Поддержка', 'Конфиденциальность', 'Условия'. DIRECTION A: ASSISTANT FIRST. Very premium asymmetric split hero. Left 52% big white headline in TWO lines 'Придайте мыслям\nформу.' and concise supporting copy 'Обсудите идею с ИИ. Соберите карту, слайды и план действий.' Right a beautifully rendered clean front-facing iPhone showing the Minor assistant with centered text 'О чём подумаем?', a soft controlled mint ambient glow behind it, input and bottom button 'Меню'. Do not reproduce the reference's old 'Карты' button. No generated logo in phone; use a delicate waveform motif instead. Entire hero with phone and CTAs fits first ~800px. Second section around 550px: title 'Один разговор. Несколько результатов.' A large purposeful editorial product composition: real-looking dark mind-map crop on left with nodes 'Запуск подкаста', 'Идея', 'Запись', and a cream slide titled 'Голос, который слышат' beside it, not stacked tiny dashboard cards. Third section around400px: 'Продолжайте с того же места.' two-column text and small task list 'Выбрать гостя', 'Записать пилот', with quiet source caption; no autosaved deck switcher. Fourth closingsection around250px: 'Начните с одной мысли.' white download CTA and simple footer. Strong product identity, enough readable detail, restrained design, not generic SaaS neon.
